title: Construct the coefficient field and its residue isomorphism
statement: Let K be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and Y a smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] finite-type K-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] of dimension d [def-kun-dimension]. Let Omega be an algebraically closed field and s:Spec(Omega) -> Y a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], with image y and a=trdeg_K kappa(y) [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Let R be the strict henselization ring [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], assumed local, with structural morphism r:Spec(R) -> Y. Equip kappa(y) with a K-algebra structure whose Spec map is Spec(kappa(y)) -> Y -> Spec(K), and equip Omega with a kappa(y)-algebra structure whose Spec map followed by Spec(kappa(y)) -> Y is s. Equip R with a K-algebra structure whose Spec map is r followed by Y -> Spec(K). There is a separably closed K-field F [def-pc-separably-closed] and a K-algebra map j:F -> R whose composite with reduction to the residue field [def-weil-residue-field] is bijective, with trdeg_K F=a.

source.place: Proof, Local calculation in dimension d, first paragraph: lift a separating basis and its separable closure; second paragraph: subtract transcendence degrees

proof.text: Apply the core theorem to identify the residue field of R with E = separableClosure k Omega, where k = kappa(y). Equip Omega with the composite K-algebra structure. The canonical residue-algebra instance and strictHenselizationResidue give strict henselianity of the chosen ring R. Put rho0 = e composed with reduction. Apply full faithfulness of Spec to hK, the core geometric-point equation, hOmega and hKappa; injectivity of E into Omega then shows rho0 is K-linear. The resulting rho is surjective and its kernel is the maximal ideal.

Full faithfulness of Spec and hKappa identify the prescribed K-algebra map into k with f.residueFieldAlgebraMap y. The base-point residue algebra is essentially finite type. Compose its map with the residueFieldIso inverse and the residue map of LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap f y, obtaining Algebra.EssFiniteType K k. Apply Mathlib exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField to obtain a finite separating family t.

Map t into E along k -> E. Algebraic independence is preserved by the injective K-algebra homomorphism. Let L0 = K(t) in k and L = K(image t) in E. Separability transitivity gives E/L0 separable. IntermediateField.equivMap, adjoin_map and equivOfEq identify L0 with L, compatibly with their maps into E; IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv transports the separability to E/L. Apply exists_section_of_separating_family to rho and the mapped family, obtaining j:E -> R with rho composed with j equal to the identity.

Take F = E with its existing field and K-algebra structures. IsSepClosure.sep_closed supplies separable closedness. Injectivity of e and the section equation show reduction composed with j = e.symm, hence it is bijective. The transcendence-degree tower formula for K -> k -> E, together with algebraicity of E/k and ha, gives trdeg_K E = a.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_strict_local_field_coeff_data
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (d a : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Y = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
    (y : Y) (hy : s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = y)
    [Algebra K (Y.residueField y)]
    (hκ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (Y.residueField y))) =
      Y.fromSpecResidueField y ≫ f)
    [Algebra (Y.residueField y) Ω]
    (hΩ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) Ω)) ≫
      Y.fromSpecResidueField y = s)
    (ha : Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField y) = (a : Cardinal))
    [Algebra K (strictHenselizationRing s)]
    (hK : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (strictHenselizationRing s))) =
      strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ≫ f)
    [IsLocalRing (strictHenselizationRing s)] :
    ∃ (F : Type u) (_ : Field F) (_ : Algebra K F),
      ∃ j : F →ₐ[K] strictHenselizationRing s,
        IsSepClosed F ∧
        Function.Bijective ((IsLocalRing.residue (strictHenselizationRing s)).comp
          j.toRingHom) ∧
        Algebra.trdeg K F = (a : Cardinal)
